sources.name: County Population Totals and Components of Change: 2020-2023 - US Census
List of United States counties and county equivalents - Wiki

_: Virginia is divided into 95 counties, along with 38 independent cities that are considered county-equivalents for census purposes.
St. Louis operates as both a city and a county.
Baltimore City, although a municipality, has been considered an independent city on par with county jurisdictions since the adoption of the Maryland Constitution of 1851.
Since June 2022, Connecticut's nine councils of government have been used by the US Census Bureau instead of the state's eight counties, which now exist for historical purposes only.
Carson City is an independent city and the capital of the U.S. state of Nevada.
Alaska is divided into 19 equivalent boroughs and 11 sparsely populated census areas.
The District of Columbia is a single federal district that is not part of any state or county.
